Message:
ALSA: hda/realtek - Enable headset mic of ASUS X430UN with ALC256

The ASUS laptop X430UN with ALC256 can't detect the headset microphone
until ALC256_FIXUP_ASUS_MIC_NO_PRESENCE quirk applied.
